notes.title: New Enemy Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=U50BfZvqWfc;full][/previewyoutube]MAJOR UPDATE: New enemy types have been added for all maps! Grab your friends and team up against The Mutant and The Ice Mutant enemy types, each with brand new movesets and abilities.

Defenders is back with another BIG update and this time we are adding some super fun, super aggressive new enemy types. These mutant enemy types have a variety of different attacks that will be sure to add some more challenge to the game!

Additionally, the option to invert X and Y axes have been added to the settings!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN SALE
notes.content: Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense is only [b]$4.99[/b] for a limited time as a part of the Steam Halloween Sale! Buy it now and play on our new map "Forest" out now which is a spooky redwood forest with dense fog. Take to the trees and pick off enemies from above on tree bridges, but be careful because enemies can do the same. Enjoy [b]new Halloween accessories[/b] and show off to your friends with a new skull mask, witch hat, and jack-o-lantern head.

notes.title: Halloween Update + New Map + New Towers!
notes.content:
MAJOR DEFENDERS UPDATE: Introducing [b]THREE NEW TOWERS: SPIKE TRAP, ICE OBELISK, TESLA COIL[/b] each with unique powers and strategies. Get even more creative with defensive strategies with these new towers that are sure to change up the game big time.

Unlock the [b]NEW MAP[/b] "Forest" out now which is a spooky redwood forest with dense fog. Take to the trees and pick off enemies from above on tree bridges, but be careful because enemies can do the same.

[b]HALLOWEEN ACCESSORIES[/b] have been added! Show off to your friends with a new skull mask, witch hat, and jack-o-lantern head.

notes.title: Customization Update + New Map!
notes.content:
MAJOR DEFENDERS UPDATE: [b]CUSTOMIZE[/b] your own character now with 20 new colors and accessories to stand out amongst your friends! You are now able to choose a base player color and choose from a male or female model! Also enjoy 8 different customizable accessories that you can put on your player like a tophat or fedora! 

Unlock the [b]NEW MAP[/b] "Tundra" out now which is a one-lane canyon map that tunnels enemies towards the Core. Place towers on high bluffs and climb up to an abandoned arctic base to pick enemies off! 

[b]ENEMY SURGES[/b] have been added! Some waves will now have an enemy surge where one type of enemy will be the only type that spawns that round. Always be prepared for a surge!

PATCH NOTES:
[list]
[*] Player customization has been added!
[*] A new map called the Tundra was added.
[*] The volume of the player’s footsteps and jumping sounds were decreased.
[*] Enemy footstep volume has been decreased.
[*] The shooting range of all towers were increased.
[*] Core Tank Enemy added.
[*] Enemy surges were added! On some waves, only enemies of a single class spawn. 
[*] FAL damage increased!
[*] Decreased countdown beep volume.
[*] Fixed screen scaling for Ultrawide resolutions
[/list]

notes.title: End of Summer SALE! Defenders is 50% off!
notes.content:
End of Summer Sale is here and Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense is 50% off! Buy Defenders at an all time low price now and tell your friends so you can play Co-op together! 

UPDATES:

We have been working hard to update the game and a BIG update is coming soon! A new map called the Tundra will be released for free and we have a huge player customization update planned! Stay tuned and buy Defenders while its on sale!

notes.title: LAUNCH DAY! Defenders will be released June 30th!
notes.content: After years of hard work, Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense will finally be released! Thanks to all of our supporters and we hope that you all enjoy the game! Download and install the game on JUNE 30TH and play with up to 3 of your friends as you use unique towers and awesome weapons to strategically defend The Core! See you in the game!

notes.title: Steam Game Festival Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense Live Stream!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Game Festival!

We are Yuboy Studios and we will be having a livestream event where you can play and chat with the developers of Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense! Download the demo and join us at 2PM EST as we livestream the game! Feel free to ask any questions about the game and give any feedback during the event!

ABOUT THE GAME:
Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense is a Cooperative First Person Shooter that redefines the tower defense genre. Team up with friends, drop in to a variety of diverse maps, and defend The Core from waves of hostiles! Destroy enemies by utilizing a wide variety of unique weapons, from lava guns to laser guns! Bolster your defenses by building towers and collect materials to craft and upgrade them! Join the fight and become a DEFENDER!
